newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo slips on mark, following European trend.
newsitem.headline: Escudo slips on mark, following European trend.

text.p: The escudo slipped against the mark in early trade on Wednesday, following the trend elsewhere in Europe, traders said.
The currency was trading at 101.00/02 marks, compared with its close on Tuesday at 100.88/91, and traders expected it to move in a range between 100.91 and 101.10 on Wednesday.
"The escudo is weaker largely due to the fall of other European currencies (against the mark). But it should not go beyond 101.05 or 101.10," said one trader.
German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Tuesday that the mark was too weak against the dollar.
